weather.scope: fixed-list replay with hypothetical weather and depth; no reactive controller, no NEO discovery rate
weather.depth_assumption: r30=20 at zenith/dark, 2arcsec seeing; uncalibrated, background/trailing loss included

assumptions: Exposure law is an uncalibrated planning prior: Patat near-zenith R, not measured Xinglong r.
Anchor is 5s at Sun=-10deg, field altitude=25deg, elongation=40deg, Moon down.
Airmass and near-Sun background factors are explicit heuristic assumptions.
No realtime feedback, no WAIT commands, no automatic telescope connection.
Lists require operator/controller start at stated time; a static list cannot enforce a deadline after arbitrary hardware delays.
Original MP coordinates and footprint vertices are preserved; no latitude extension.

coverage.method: HEALPix pixel centres within original four-corner spherical polygons; nominal, not weather-adjusted

trojan_compatibility.scope: Existing B Trojan scheduling and science yields are preserved, not rerun by this twilight experiment
